JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: User journal entry containing content, reflection turns, tags, and metadata

id.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry

content.description: Main body text of the reflection or journal entry

mood.description: Mood or emotional state associated with the entry

mode.description: Reflection mode (reflection, summary, brainstorm, socratic, gratitude)

isPinned.description: Whether the entry is pinned to top of history

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: User-isolated collection storing multi-turn journal reflections and Gemini conversation turns
